title: Benefits Registry — conveyor buildout (retrospective, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Benefits Registry — conveyor buildout

Programme-level benefits registry for the conveyor buildout, recorded under programme id 01a1d039-0d24-7d16-ae52-4841e96ccfac (MSP §8.3).

## Benefit profiles

The record holds 7 benefit profiles, referenced B1 to B7: 3 active (B1, B6, B7) and 4 draft (B2–B5). Their categories are governance (B1), programme benefit (B2–B5), delivery (B6) and efficiency (B7). All 7 name the same benefit owner, job 01a1db6b-4f17-7e76-838d-590d71578ad1.

| Reference | Benefit | Category | Status | Baseline | Target | Measurement | KPI | Owner job |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| B1 | Auditable decisions | governance | active | 105 approval_decision / 662 run at 2026-11-22 (decisions per run; value 0.15861) | every choice has a decision row | Count decision rows per run from the action ledger. | decisions per run: 0.15861 | 01a1db6b-4f17-7e76-838d-590d71578ad1 |
| B2 | Less bespoke tooling | programme benefit | draft | not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project) | every service a job uses is a toolkit; a toolkit with no calls in a cycle is retired or justified | The tool_call ledger's per-toolkit counts, read at the tranche review; retirement is a decision. | zero-use toolkits retired after a programme cycle (P10) | 01a1db6b-4f17-7e76-838d-590d71578ad1 |
| B3 | Self-development | programme benefit | draft | not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project) | one self-development run reaches live verification on evidence; a second is repeatable | The development project's run, CI and deploy records; the lane and PR are the evidence. | a development run reaches live verification with a recorded rollback | 01a1db6b-4f17-7e76-838d-590d71578ad1 |
| B4 | Public collaboration | programme benefit | draft | not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project) | at least one outside contribution changes a published output; every output is reachable | The GitHub issue registry and merged PR authors; the publications are recorded on the programme issues. | an outside issue or PR that changes a published output | 01a1db6b-4f17-7e76-838d-590d71578ad1 |
| B5 | One model | programme benefit | draft | not measured - no instrument exists (recorded as a kata on the kata project) | the T0 gate exists and refuses a second store; the registry has one home | The T0 gate test and the absorption inventory; a second store is a defect. | no concept with two stores (the T0 gate) | 01a1db6b-4f17-7e76-838d-590d71578ad1 |
| B6 | Predictable delivery | delivery | active | check-registers at /tmp/conveyor-526-reg-snap (open register findings; value 28.0) | the seed, coverage and published checklist agree at every tranche review | coverage.json and seed/programme.json regenerated and checked in CI; the P0 checklist counts the published set. | open register findings: 28.0 | 01a1db6b-4f17-7e76-838d-590d71578ad1 |
| B7 | Tokens per accepted deliverable | efficiency | active | 9,458,468 inference tokens / 15 demo-credited deliverables at 2026-11-22 (tokens per demo-credited deliverable; value 630565) | 20% reduction on the primary denominator (tokens per demo-credited deliverable; value 504452) | inference ledger total tokens / demo-credited deliverables | tokens per demo-credited deliverable: baseline 630565, target 504452; run failure rate: ceiling baseline + 0.5pp | 01a1db6b-4f17-7e76-838d-590d71578ad1 |

Risks are recorded on every profile: register references R7 (B1), R2 (B6) and R10 (B7), and a written risk on B2 to B5. Preconditions are recorded on B2, B3, B4 and B5.

_Source: msp.json#/benefit_profiles_

## Map

6 map links record the output, capability, operational outcome and strategic objective each benefit is realised through. The links cover B1 to B6; B7 has no map link in this record. Every link has kind 'benefit'.

| Reference | Benefit | Output | Capability | Operational outcome | Strategic objective |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| B1 | Auditable decisions | T2 decision ladder | every choice is traceable to a policy and a person | O3 Every decision is auditable | decision ladder (rule -> laya -> generation -> human) |
| B2 | Less bespoke tooling | T13 tool platform | services with no calls are retired | O4 Every tool is governed | versioned toolkit with a probe, binding and ledger |
| B3 | Self-development | T6 development project | the conveyor changes itself with rollback | O5 The conveyor develops and operates itself | development projects under gates |
| B4 | Public collaboration | DESIGN-PUBLISH public site | an outside review changes a published output | O6 The public can see and challenge the design | public repository and published outputs |
| B5 | One model | T0 model and contracts | a concept has one table | O1 One model, one store | one store and one action registry |
| B6 | Predictable delivery | P0 + T1 plan spine | the plan and the measurement agree | O2 Jobs, not code paths | programme plan and coverage instrument |

_Source: msp.json#/benefit_links_
